product.title: Zion Full Day Small Group Tour with Narrows

description.text: Join a small-group full-day tour of Zion National Park that combines shuttle logistics, scenic overlooks, and a guided Narrows hike when river conditions allow. The itinerary covers Riverside Walk, Emerald Pools, Court of the Patriarchs, and bottom-up Narrows wading with a certified guide pacing the group. Maximum group size stays small for a social but uncrowded canyon experience. Park entrance fees and trail snacks are included.

highlights: Guided bottom-up Narrows hike when permitted
Riverside Walk and Emerald Pools stops

start.description: Meet at Zion Outfitter in Springdale, UT 84767 at your confirmed morning departure time.

end.description: Return to the Springdale meeting point after the final canyon trail.
